title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-gpu-iam-networking-migration
author: Priya Raman
description:
Consolidates and standardizes the Terraform state layout and modules used for Private deployments: GPU node pools, IAM roles, and VPC/networking. Motivation: we observed multiple ad-hoc state layouts across customer installs which made upgrades and cross-region restores error-prone. This PR introduces a single canonical state layout, renames resources to a stable namespace, and provides a migration helper script plus documented step-by-step migration plan.

What this changes: unified modules/gpu-node-pool, modules/iam, modules/networking and a new modules/state-layout that contains naming conventions and state mappings. Adds scripts/tfstate-migrate.sh to perform terraform state mv operations in a safe, idempotent way and examples/private-deploy showing updated backend config. Updates README with migration and rollback instructions.

Migration plan (high level): backup existing remote state -> run dry-run mode of scripts/tfstate-migrate.sh to verify planned state moves -> apply moves in a staging workspace -> run terraform plan/apply for dependent workspaces -> rotate IAM role names and validate with smoke tests -> finish with production switch. Script creates a timestamped backup and logs all operations.

Backward compatibility and rollback: this is a state migration (breaking) but included migration script supports rolling back by reversing the moves. We also provide terraform state list outputs in the state-layout module to help diff environments.

Testing and validation: ran full private-installer end-to-end in our GCP CI target and a subset of AWS scenarios in local test harness (see ci checks). Included unit tests for module outputs and added smoke test that validates node pool taints and GPU count.

Notes: This PR is intentionally conservative in API changes to modules (keeps existing input names where possible) but renames exported resource addresses; customers will need to run the migration helper. See release notes and README for exact commands.

Checklist: 
- [x] Module refactor with stable naming
- [x] Migration script + dry-run
- [x] README + examples updated
- [x] CI e2e + unit smoke tests
- [x] Reviewer approvals

rollback_instructions: If migration fails: run scripts/tfstate-migrate.sh --reverse --mapping modules/state-layout/addresses.tf --target=<workspace> to move addresses back
Restore from backup: use the timestamped state file created by the backup step and re-configure the backend to point to restored state before applying
